description: Sanz Rodrigo, Javier and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The implemented coupling workflow connects mesoscale atmospheric information with microscale wind-flow modelling for wind-energy assessment. The source describes SOWFA-based work. A related GABLS3-CFDWindSCM notebook archive supplies coupling-validation context using a different solver. These components belong to the same research programme but are not identical code. The platform record preserves the solver distinction and bounds its validation claims to the stated examples. Public availability of the companion notebook does not prove unrestricted source access for every coupling component. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-nc-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
